messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: rmr 2.0.2 released
parts:
Hi,
just to say that rmr 2.0.2 is available, with reduced dependencies (in particular httr and curl-devel are no longer needed) and compatible with the latest Rcpp, which was a problem for most people using R 1.15.2. It also has a number of bug fixes mostly related to equijoins.
See the Changelog and do not hesitate with feedback, either here or on the issue tracker.

Antonio
